# Troubleshooting and Recovery

## Purpose

Standardize response for common stage failures and reduce ad-hoc debugging.

## Failure routing

```{=latex}
\begin{center}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
  >=Latex,
  node distance=1.2cm and 1.7cm,
  box/.style={draw, rounded corners, align=center, minimum width=3.0cm, minimum height=0.8cm},
  decision/.style={draw, diamond, aspect=2, align=center, inner sep=1pt}
]
\node[box] (fail) {Run failure};
\node[decision, below=of fail] (classify) {issue type};

\node[box, below left=of classify] (env) {environment/CLI};
\node[box, below=of classify] (data) {input/path};
\node[box, below right=of classify] (config) {config semantics};
\node[box, right=of data] (stage) {artifact missing};

\node[box, below=of env] (fixenv) {repair env and reinstall};
\node[box, below=of data] (fixdata) {fix paths and sample lists};
\node[box, below=of config] (fixconfig) {correct step config};
\node[box, below=of stage] (rerun) {rerun required stage};

\draw[->] (fail) -- (classify);
\draw[->] (classify) -- (env);
\draw[->] (classify) -- (data);
\draw[->] (classify) -- (config);
\draw[->] (classify) -- (stage);
\draw[->] (env) -- (fixenv);
\draw[->] (data) -- (fixdata);
\draw[->] (config) -- (fixconfig);
\draw[->] (stage) -- (rerun);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{center}
```

## Common problems

| Symptom | Likely cause | Recovery |
|---|---|---|
| `command not found: methyl-validation` | `.venv` inactive or install missing | Activate `.venv`, rerun `scripts/install_all.sh` |
| freeze fails for missing stable panel | stability not run or wrong path | Run `--stability` or set `freeze_stable_dmp_csv` |
| model fails due to biological review gate | `require_biological_review_for_model=true` and not confirmed | set `biological_review_confirmed=true` after review |
| path file-not-found across hosts | environment path differences | use `path_remap`/`--path-remap OLD=NEW` |
| blind predictor rejected in validation mode | blind settings passed to `methyl-validation` | run blind mode with standalone `methyl-predictor` |

## Safe recovery sequence

1. Validate environment and CLI availability.
2. Confirm previous-stage artifacts exist.
3. Re-run failed stage only.
4. Use resume mode where supported.
5. Re-check QA gates before advancing.

## Resume examples

```bash
source .venv/bin/activate
methyl-validation --project /work/prostate-cancer/configs/project_Healthy_vs_PCa1-4-CG.json --stability --resume
methyl-validation --project /work/prostate-cancer/configs/project_Healthy_vs_PCa1-4-CG.json --post-model-validation --resume
```

## Operational guardrails

- Keep original run directories for traceability.
- Prefer additive reruns over manual artifact edits.
- Record config overrides used in reruns.
